title: docs: say `pnpm run setup` for the first-time install and spec build
body:
Fixes #24357
Clause-②: no

## What changed

One line in each of two files, net ±0 lines per file:

- `AGENTS.md`, Build & Test block: `pnpm setup` becomes `pnpm run setup`, and the comment now ends ``(bare `pnpm setup` is pnpm's own built-in)``, so the next edit does not tidy the `run` away. The comment column stays aligned with the lines around it.
- `examples/README.md`, Getting started block: `pnpm setup` becomes `pnpm run setup`. The comment column stays aligned.

Nothing else is touched. The root `package.json` `setup` script is unchanged.

## Why: measured on pnpm 10.31.0

10.31.0 is both the root `packageManager` pin and the container's `pnpm --version`. Every probe of the bare form ran with `HOME`, `SHELL=/bin/bash` and `XDG_DATA_HOME` / `XDG_CONFIG_HOME` / `XDG_CACHE_HOME` / `XDG_STATE_HOME` pointed at a throwaway directory in the session scratchpad, with `PNPM_HOME` unset. I read the sha256 of the container's real `~/.bashrc`, `~/.zshrc` and `~/.profile` before and after every probe, and none of them changed.

| probe | where | what ran | exit |
|---|---|---|---|
| bare `pnpm setup` | a fixture project whose only script is `setup`, which writes a marker file | pnpm's built-in. It created the throwaway `.bashrc` with the `# pnpm` ... `export PNPM_HOME=...` ... `# pnpm end` block and printed "To start using pnpm, run: source ...". No marker file. | 0 |
| `pnpm run setup` | the same fixture | the script. It printed `SETUP_SCRIPT_RAN` and wrote the marker file. | 0 |
| bare `pnpm setup` | this repo's root at `a2a3777bf5` | the built-in again, with the same rc block. No install output. `packages/spec/dist` was absent before and after. | 0 |
| `pnpm run setup` | this repo's root, with the real `HOME` so it uses the real store | `pnpm install && pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build`. It printed `Already up to date`, ran the spec build to `check-dts-emitted: 38/38` and stamped `packages/spec/dist/.build-input-hash`. | 0 (`os-verify-lock` `VERDICT command-exit 0`) |

So the failure is silent. Bare `pnpm setup` exits 0, prints text that looks like success, and edits the contributor's shell rc. It leaves no install and no spec build behind. `pnpm help setup` agrees: "Usage: pnpm setup. Sets up pnpm".

## Every `pnpm setup` hit and its disposition

On the base, `git grep -nE 'pnpm setup\b' a2a3777bf5 -- . ':!**/CHANGELOG.md'` found 3 hits. The excluded `CHANGELOG.md` files have 0 hits, and they are release-owned anyway.

| hit | disposition |
|---|---|
| `AGENTS.md:40` | a first-time setup command: changed |
| `examples/README.md:42` | a first-time setup command: changed |
| `.github/workflows/lint.yml:157` | YAML comment prose ("checkout, Node and pnpm setup, the caches, the install, ...") about setting pnpm up, not the command: untouched, and outside this card's file surface |

After the change, the same grep finds 2 hits: `lint.yml:157`, and the new `AGENTS.md` comment, which names the bare form on purpose. On the base, `git grep -nE 'pnpm run setup'` found 0 hits.

I also intersected the 206 root `package.json` script names with pnpm 10's command names. The only other collisions are `test`, where pnpm's built-in runs the script so nothing breaks, and `version`, which every tracked caller already spells `pnpm run version`.

## The open choice I settled: the comment clause

Should the `AGENTS.md` line say why it is `run`? I judged it on the four axes. **Business need:** the readers are first-time contributors and every new agent session, and bare `pnpm setup` is exactly what they ran. **Long-term soundness:** the clause states the trap once, where the command lives, with no gate and no new file. **Making AI mistakes structurally harder:** an agent that knows `pnpm SCRIPT` normally runs a script will shorten `pnpm run setup` back to `pnpm setup`. The clause names why this one must keep `run`, and that shortening is how the defect got in. **No scope spread:** one line, no number, no incident narrative (`check:pm-skill-id-lint` is green). `examples/README.md` gets only the `run`, because its readers follow it rather than edit it.

## Changeset

None. The PR carries the `skip-changeset` label: both files are repo-root docs, and no package's `files[]` ships either of them. The devx lane rule says root `scripts/`, docs and test-only changes get `skip-changeset`.

## Gates (local subset, at `2601bcc81`)

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 42 commands for the two paths, the same list as the dispatch-time reading. I ran each one in the worktree and captured its exit code before any pipe:

- 40 exited 0. That includes `check:pm-governed-prose`, `check:pm-governed-merges`, `check:pm-skill-id-lint` (87 files clean), `check:pm-skill-ratchet`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:cross-package-test-inputs`, `check:published-files`, `check:test-source-alias` and `check:examples-live-imports`, plus every `node scripts/check-*.mjs` row and its `--self-test`.
- 2 exited 3 with `PREREQUISITE NOT MET`, which reads as NOT MEASURED, not as a failure: `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `pnpm check:lean-entry-closure`. Both load built output of packages this diff does not touch, and only `packages/spec` is built in this worktree. CI's Build Core and Lint jobs run them over a full build.
- `check:dts-closure` and `check:sourcemap-no-sources-content` exited 0 but swept 1 built package (`@objectstack/spec`) for the same reason.
- `dispatch-gates --ran` with `COMMAND :: exit CODE` lines printed: "42 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 40 run, 2 NOT-MEASURED (2 DERIVED from a recorded exit 3)".

No package is touched, so no package build closure, `pnpm test` or `pnpm typecheck` is owed. No tested behaviour changed, so there is no ablation. Every family CI runs on the PR is read from the PR's check-runs, not re-run here.

## Acceptance notes

- `examples/README.md` runs `pnpm install` on the line above `pnpm run setup`, and the script runs `pnpm install` again. That is redundant but harmless, since the second install is a no-op. It is polish, not a defect, so I left it as written. Carrier: none.
- Renaming the root script to a name pnpm does not own would remove the trap at its source instead of documenting it. I did not take that route. It changes `package.json` outside this card's file surface, objectui kept the `setup` name and moved its docs to `pnpm run setup`, and nothing in this repo calls the script by any other spelling. Carrier: none.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么**:`AGENTS.md`「Build & Test」段和 `examples/README.md`「Getting started」段里首次安装的那一行,`pnpm setup` 改成 `pnpm run setup`。`AGENTS.md` 那一行的注释补了半句,说明裸 `pnpm setup` 是 pnpm 自带的命令。每个文件只改一行,行数不变。

**为什么改**:pnpm 10 下,裸 `pnpm setup` 跑的是 pnpm 自带的 setup 命令,它往 shell 配置文件里写 `PNPM_HOME`。仓库根 `package.json` 里的 setup 脚本(装依赖 + 构建 spec)根本不会跑。这个命令以 0 退出,打印的提示看起来像成功了,所以照 `AGENTS.md` 做首次安装的新同事或新 agent 会以为已经装好,实际上依赖没装、spec 没构建,shell 配置还被改了。两种写法都在本仓根目录和一个隔离夹具里实测过,全程没碰真实的 rc 文件。

**风险与代价(含回滚)**:只改两行文档,不碰代码,没有发布面,不加门禁。代价是首次安装命令多了 4 个字符。回滚就是 revert 这个 PR。`AGENTS.md` 是 Tier H 治理面,所以整个 PR 要等你批准才能落地。

**席位意见**:

**你要做的**:看一下这两行 diff,同意就给一次批准(APPROVED review),之后由席位落地。如果不想要注释里那半句,告诉席位只保留 `pnpm run setup` 即可。
